description: Politics gets loud, but the needs of families, workers, students, and small businesses are not complicated. People want breathing room, safe communities, honest government, strong schools, protected rights, and a future they can prepare for instead of fear. Nicholas Ryan Holbrook is running to focus on practical problems with humility, accountability, and a commitment to serve people before party machinery.
